review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 52 physical PDF pages; pages 1, 6, 8, 10, 15, 16, 17, 21, 23, 34, 35 and 36 were additionally rendered to verify dropped lines, figure-internal labels, the page-1 footnote and the repaired reference URLs. The OCR contains no code fences and the PDF prints none, so no fence-repair is needed; all equations, appendix tables (Tables 13-21) and sampled numeric values match the source. Remaining non-matching PDF lines are figure-internal labels whose figures are embedded (Figures 2-8, 10, 12) or the vertical arXiv sidebar stamp on physical p.1, which is not body content. The OCR splits reference [45] into two paragraphs at the PDF page break after "Stefan Schaal," and uses hyphens for the printed "warmup–stable–decay"; both preserve content and were left unchanged.
